title: Naturality of transported native integral Hom counits
statement: Given a normalized TensorPresentation a, a closed native structure S, and a tensor isomorphism e transporting a.tensor to the exchanged native tensor, the transported native counit is natural in the first derived argument.

source.place: Lemma 08J9, functoriality of the internal-Hom evaluation.

proof.text: Expand transportedCounit and use naturality of e to replace maps of a.tensor by maps of the exchanged native tensor.
Apply evaluation_naturality of the native CoefficientClosedStructure and reassociate compositions.

mathlib_searches.query: naturality of counit after tensor bifunctor isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: Native CoefficientClosedStructure.evaluation_naturality is the exact formal ingredient.

from.place: Proof decomposition: formal naturality after native transport.

lean.statement: theorem transportedCounit_naturality (X : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (a : TensorPresentation.{u, u} X R) (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (hom.{u, u} X R)) (e : a.tensor ≅ swapTensor S.tensor) (K K' W : Derived.{u, u} X R) (f : K' ⟶ K) : a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K') ((hom.{u, u} X R).map (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 W)))) ≫ transportedCounit X R a S e K' W = a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫ transportedCounit X R a S e K W
